description: Use before setting a priority fee. Gives prices in the exact unit Compute Budget expects (micro-lamports per compute unit) and the total cost in SOL, so you never overpay by a unit mistake. Turns recent on-chain priority fees into three price tiers and, when you pass your transaction, a compute limit and exact cost for each tier. Inputs: transaction (optional): Optional. Your transaction, so fees are measured on the accounts it writes to and compute is measured by simulation. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/fee_advice.
name: fee_advice
